maya (Design): Quick thought — the new performance chart legend feels noisy. Model > region hierarchy should read as a single affordance (lighter sublabel), and the mini-sparklines have really low contrast on dark mode. attaching screenshot (will drop in #screenshots).
sam (PM): Agree on noise. Also noticed unit labels flip between 'tokens/s' and 't/s' across dashboards. Can we standardize copy first?
alex (Eng): We currently render legend labels from the metrics service payload. We can add an optional `shortLabel` field and fall back to it for compact mode. For sparklines I can bump alpha. cc @jules for a11y guidance.
jules (Accessibility): Contrast is borderline. Small inline sparklines + light strokes fail 3:1 on dark bg — recommend text at 4.5:1 and decorative lines >= 3:1. Also ensure each legend entry has proper focus target; keyboard nav should jump to the whole legend row, not just the label. :a11y: :eyes:
maya (Design): Proposal: collapse minor series under a "More" chevron to reduce horizontal clutter. Also the smoothing is a bit aggressive — spikes are important for ops. Suggest an "adaptive smoothing" toggle (on by default) that only smooths when series are dense and low-variance.
alex (Eng): Example pseudocode for adaptive smoothing I had in mind:
```
if len(series) > 80 and stdev(series) < 0.12:
  apply_gaussian_smooth(series, sigma=1.2)
else:
  render_series(series)
```
That should preserve spikes for short or high-variance series.
sam (PM): Hover hint copy idea: "Smoothing is applied to improve readability; toggle off to view original data." Might be concise enough for tooltip. Thoughts?
jules (Accessibility): Wording looks fine but avoid the word "original" alone — better to use "original (unsmoothed) data" for clarity. For aria-label: `Smoothing applied; press to view unsmoothed data` — keep it explicit for screen reader users.
maya (Design): Minor UX nit: axis unit shorthands should expand on hover (e.g., `t/s → tokens per second`). Also consider showing a contextual unit legend when multiple unit types appear in the same panel.
alex (Eng): I'll prototype these: add `shortLabel`, legend chevron collapse, increase sparkline alpha from 0.4 -> 0.65, and wire the adaptive smoothing flag. Will open a draft PR later today and flag for review.
sam (PM): Nice. Request: default collapse threshold = 5 series? And run a quick perf smoke for client-side rendering impact.
maya (Design): +1 on threshold 5. Also let's do quick qualitative check with the customer dashboard sample before full rollout.
jules (Accessibility): When you have the prototype, please run the axe checks and a color-contrast snapshot. Happy to review keyboard flow.
alex (Eng): Will do. I'll ping this thread when the branch is up.
maya (Design): Thanks all — syncing with UX review on Tuesday to validate copy and focus behavior. :thumbsup:
